messages:
sarah: FYI CPU/GPU node bootstrap failures started after we moved audit logs to 90d retention; seeing keystore decrypt spikes and warm-pool joins timing out. Investigating.
ajay: Decrypt QPS + conntrack in ap-south and eu-west-1. Lots of S3 exporter retries too.
leo: Did any egress firewall changes land recently in those regions?
matt: I rolled fw/hardening v3.2 last night which applied default-deny outbound for hosts. infra-bot shows the rollout at 2026-03-20T02:01Z. I missed updating keystore allowlist.
infra-bot: deploy: fw/hardening v3.2 by matt — success — 2026-03-20T02:01Z
ajay: Default-deny likely blocked privatelink path to keystore, falling back to NAT and amplifying conntrack and cost. Short-term: open egress for keystore CIDR and reduce audit-exporter sampling to 10%.
sarah: Which SG and exact CLI to run? We need a swoop-and-fix to restore GPU onboarding.
ajay: Proposal: authorize egress on sg-0a1b2c3d to 10.0.123.0/24 TCP443 for 1h, and patch audit-exporter sampling to 10%. Commands:
aws ec2 authorize-security-group-egress --group-id sg-0a1b2c3d --protocol tcp --port 443 --cidr 10.0.123.0/24 --region ap-south-1
kubectl -n infra patch configmap/audit-exporter -p '{"data":{"sampling_pct":"10"}}'
Expected decrypt QPS reduction ~65-75% and NAT cost drop.
matt: I'll flip the SG for AZ-a and AZ-b as a canary and monitor keystore.decrypt.qps, gpu.join.success_rate, nat.egress_bytes. Will revert in 1h or sooner if no improvement.
sarah: Also whitelist S3 exporter endpoints so retries don't call KMS. Create infra-config PR for that.
matt: PR created (WIP): https://git.internal/redwood/infra-config/pull/482
ops-oncall: I'll watch metrics and roll back if join rate doesn't improve in 30m. Ping me on flip.
ajay: Medium-term: presigned S3 uploads for exporter, increase privatelink capacity, and default sampled-logging. I'll draft a runbook.
sarah: Good. Execute canary + sampler change now. Keep communication tight.
matt: flipping canary in 5m.
ops-oncall: :eyes: ready to act.
sarah: thanks team :thumbsup:
